lastText: OHLLAGEBERICHTHome19141915191619171918HARD MODE — EROSION 7/7-9MANPOWER-6MUNITIONS-1HOME FRONTX.1918A File Too ThickThere is no single order that did this and no single refusal. There is a file, and in it a pattern of a Chief who spent the Supreme Command's standing at home to buy results in the field, and went on spending it after the results stopped arriving. A command that has consumed that much of the country's patience does not get to choose the moment it stops. Somebody else chooses, and they choose now.Contested judgmentThe office continues. The occupant does not.Return to file
